title: Legacy Models: Archaeology to Native Lineage
license: Open educational and research use; preserve attribution and provenance metadata.

rtt_mode.purpose: Convert unknown inherited model influence into inspectable, confidence-bounded lineage without asserting causation from resemblance alone.

intent.problem: Model-based AI systems may inherit structures, phrases, procedures, evaluations, and behavioral tendencies after source identity has been weakened or discarded during crawling, filtering, training, distillation, fine-tuning, merging, retrieval, and repeated publication cycles.
intent.goal: Provide an executable RTT-aligned workflow for legacy-model archaeology, transition-model reconstruction plus provenance, and later-system native lineage.
intent.non_goal: This module does not claim that a similar output proves copying, access, training inclusion, causal influence, or priority.
intent.consequential_threshold: AI becomes consequential when its outputs or autonomous actions materially affect people, institutions, infrastructure, scientific claims, governance, or successor systems. At that threshold, unresolved lineage must be treated as an operational risk rather than optional metadata.

three_stage_model.label: archaeology
three_stage_model.lineage_state: mostly absent, lossy, or externally reconstructed
three_stage_model.primary_action: Recover candidate ancestry from artifacts, dates, versions, repeated crawls, structural signatures, known training disclosures, and independent comparisons.
three_stage_model.allowed_output: candidate lineage with explicit confidence and unresolved alternatives
three_stage_model.forbidden_output: unique causal ancestry asserted from similarity alone

three_stage_model.label: reconstruction_plus_provenance
three_stage_model.lineage_state: mixed inherited opacity plus newly preserved provenance
three_stage_model.primary_action: Reconstruct unknown ancestral branches while attaching durable source, transformation, dataset, run, retrieval, tool, and evaluation records to all new work.
three_stage_model.allowed_output: hybrid lineage graph separating reconstructed edges from natively recorded edges
three_stage_model.forbidden_output: silently merging inferred and observed lineage

three_stage_model.label: native_lineage
three_stage_model.lineage_state: lineage is a first-class system property
three_stage_model.primary_action: Preserve and expose machine-readable ancestry, transformation history, uncertainty, validation state, and successor inheritance at creation time.
three_stage_model.allowed_output: auditable claim and artifact lineage with bounded privacy and security controls
three_stage_model.forbidden_output: consequential output without a lineage status, even when the status is unknown

canon_dependencies.use: Provides the inspectable structural wrapper and bounded agent posture used to coordinate archaeology and provenance tasks.
Separates claim, evidence, interpretation, uncertainty, validation state, and presentation strength.
Represents ancestry, branch relations, derivative artifacts, and continuity across versions and systems.
Finds candidate structural correspondences without treating resemblance as proof of influence.
Builds inspectable arguments from claims, evidence, counterevidence, assumptions, and unresolved alternatives.
Detects evaluator, terminology, confidence, and reconstruction drift across repeated runs.
Models lineage as a dimensional layer and tracks drift, coherence, regime transitions, and framework inheritance.
Resolves canonical definitions, operator meanings, module versions, and declared boundaries before inference.

CANON_RESOLVE.purpose: Load canonical definitions, module manifests, version boundaries, and operator meanings before analysis.

CRAWL_SNAPSHOT.purpose: Capture a time-bounded source observation with content hash, retrieval context, access path, and collection policy.

REPEAT_CRAWL.purpose: Revisit candidate sources across time or independent collection routes to detect version changes, disappearance, mirroring, and derivative propagation.

ARTIFACT_FINGERPRINT.purpose: Generate comparable lexical, structural, procedural, mathematical, metadata, and version fingerprints.

STRUCTURAL_DETECT.purpose: Locate candidate alignments in operators, ordering, rare combinations, equations, examples, errors, formatting, or transformation signatures.

TEMPORAL_ORDER.purpose: Establish only the dates and version order supported by retained records.

LINEAGE_BRANCH.purpose: Create candidate ancestry, derivation, convergence, contamination, retrieval, or unknown-source branches without premature collapse.

PROVENANCE_ATTACH.purpose: Attach source, license, transformation, dataset, run, tool, retrieval, evaluation, and successor metadata to a node or edge.

RESONANCE_TRUTH_EVALUATE.purpose: Classify each lineage statement by evidence state rather than binary truth labeling.

DRIFT_CALIBRATE.purpose: Compare repeated analyses for changing terminology, thresholds, evaluator behavior, confidence, and omitted alternatives.

SARG_CHALLENGE.purpose: Generate the strongest evidence-bounded challenges to every proposed lineage edge.

COHERENCE_CHECK.purpose: Verify that graph edges, confidence values, citations, dates, hashes, and status labels do not contradict one another.

REGIME_SHIFT.purpose: Move a system between archaeology, reconstruction plus provenance, and native-lineage regimes only when entry criteria are satisfied.

UNKNOWN_PRESERVE.purpose: Retain unresolved ancestry as an explicit unknown node rather than inventing a parent.

steps.required_when: source volatility, weak archival coverage, unknown version order, or possible repeated absorption exists
more than one analysis run, model, evaluator, crawl, or system generation exists

legacy_models.mandatory_warning: Reconstructed lineage is probabilistic and may remain non-unique because earlier pipelines may have discarded source identity.

native_records_for_new_work: training, fine-tuning, distillation, or merge run ID
transition_models.display_rule: Native and reconstructed lineage must remain visibly distinct.

native_requirements: every consequential claim has a lineage status
every lineage edge declares evidence state
privacy and security restrictions are recorded rather than silently omitted
successor systems inherit lineage metadata and validation history
lineage loss triggers a bounded operational regime
later_systems.failure_mode: A consequential system without usable lineage enters restricted output, human review, or explicit validation-pending mode according to deployment policy.

allowed: Artifact A existed before Artifact B according to the cited records.
A and B share a structurally distinctive pattern.
A was included in a declared dataset or retrieval record.
The evidence supports candidate influence at the stated confidence.
Independent convergence remains a viable alternative.
The source of this inherited structure is unknown.
prohibited_without_direct_evidence: A specific source caused a specific internal representation.
A crawler observation proves training inclusion.

input.subject_artifact: Required artifact, model output, claim, module, dataset, or behavior to investigate.
input.available_records: Sources, snapshots, hashes, manifests, run logs, commits, archives, disclosures, evaluations, and prior lineage graphs.

output.lineage_graph: Nodes and typed edges with evidence states.
output.claim_ledger: Every lineage claim with sources, alternatives, and validation state.
output.unknowns: Explicit unresolved parents, intervals, and transformations.
output.drift_report: Differences across crawls, evaluators, models, or generations.
output.next_actions: Bounded searches, repeat crawls, reproduction requests, or provenance upgrades.
output.regime_decision: Remain in stage, advance stage, or enter restricted validation-pending mode.

halt_conditions: A requested conclusion exceeds available evidence.
Source access would violate privacy, security, law, license, or declared policy.
The graph becomes incoherent and cannot be repaired without inventing evidence.
A consequential claim lacks a usable lineage status.
The evaluator cannot distinguish reconstructed from natively recorded provenance.

validation_tests.name: No resemblance-to-causation collapse
validation_tests.pass_condition: Structural resemblance alone never emits direct_recorded_derivation, declared_training_inclusion, or candidate_influence above the configured evidence threshold.

validation_tests.name: Unknown parent preservation
validation_tests.pass_condition: Missing ancestry produces an unknown_parent node with search history rather than an invented source.

validation_tests.name: Native versus reconstructed separation
validation_tests.pass_condition: Every edge is visibly marked native, reconstructed, declared-only, or unknown.

validation_tests.name: Repeat-crawl drift detection
validation_tests.pass_condition: Changed, removed, mirrored, or republished content is represented as a versioned change set.

validation_tests.name: Counterevidence retention
validation_tests.pass_condition: Contradictory records and independent-convergence alternatives remain attached after scoring.

validation_tests.name: Consequential lineage gate
validation_tests.pass_condition: A consequential output without lineage status is marked validation_pending or placed into the deployment-defined restricted regime.

validation_tests.name: Successor inheritance
validation_tests.pass_condition: A successor receives lineage graph, claim ledger, unknowns, validation history, and drift baseline without loss.

example_run.scenario: A legacy model emits a rare structural sequence that resembles an earlier public module, but no training manifest survives.

required_next_actions: repeat crawl candidate sources and mirrors
compare archived versions and commit dates
search available dataset and retrieval manifests
preserve unknown parent if no stronger evidence appears
result.permitted_statement: The model output and the earlier module share a distinctive structural pattern; available records do not establish access, training inclusion, or causal influence.

governance.privacy: Store the minimum source detail needed for audit. Redact or seal sensitive records while preserving the fact, scope, and reason for restriction.
governance.security: Do not expose secrets, personal data, exploit paths, proprietary weights, or protected system details merely to increase lineage completeness.
governance.attribution: Credit recorded contributors and sources without converting uncertain ancestry into definitive authorship claims.
governance.correction: Never erase superseded lineage claims. Append corrections, changed confidence, failed reproductions, and reasons.
governance.human_review: Required for consequential disputes, identity-sensitive attribution, legal claims, or irreversible deployment actions.

completion_state.legacy_models: Archaeology remains confidence-bounded and preserves unknowns.
completion_state.transition_models: All new work has native receipts while inherited opacity is reconstructed without conflation.
completion_state.later_systems: Lineage, uncertainty, validation, and successor inheritance are native system behaviors.
completion_state.final_principle: Do not require perfect ancestry before acting; require honest ancestry state before becoming consequential.
